name: China Sports Industry Group Co., Ltd. (中体产业集团, SSE 600158)
via: Shanghai-listed sports company; its largest shareholder is the Sports Fund Management Centre of the General Administration of Sport of China (19.49% at 2026-06-30), and East Money lists the General Administration of Sport as its actual controller
note: State-controlled listed company: the General Administration of Sport of China (国家体育总局), a government body, is the actual controller.
